title: Energy Assistance Liaison Note: The Latest Pledge and the Cash Part of a Payment Arrangements Down Payment
content:
*Energy assistance liaison note — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)*

**How much of the latest pledge counts toward the cash part of the down payment.** How much of the latest energy assistance pledge counts toward the cash part of the down payment follows its age, on tiers that count pledges toward the down payment:

1. where the tier counts pledges toward the down payment and the latest pledge on the service account was recorded within the pledge hold days of the service account's rate schedule (under Electric Service by Rate Schedule) before the acceptance day, it counts at 100 percent (1.0) of its amount;
2. where the tier counts pledges and the latest pledge is older than that but within the tier's pledge lookback of 90 calendar days, it counts at 50 percent (0.5) of its amount;
3. otherwise no pledge counts.

The pledge that counts reduces the cash part of the down payment required, which never falls below zero.

**Tiers that count pledges toward the down payment**

| Tier | Counts pledges | Pledge lookback |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | no | 90 days |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | yes | 90 days |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | yes | 90 days |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | yes | 90 days |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | no | 90 days |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | no | 90 days |

**Age of the pledge.** The age is the number of calendar days from the pledge's recording date to the acceptance day. Only the latest pledge recorded on the service account is read.

**Hypothetical (hold days of 30):** a down payment required of $60.00 and a latest pledge of $45.00 on a Winter Protection Payment Agreement.

| Pledge age on the acceptance day | Pledge counted | Cash part of the down payment |
|---|---|---|
| 30 days | $45.00 | $15.00 |
| 31 days | $22.50 | $37.50 |
| 90 days | $22.50 | $37.50 |
| 91 days | nothing | $60.00 |

On a Standard Deferred Payment Agreement no pledge counts, whatever its age.
